Kit summary

Soul SwipeBasic
Deals 100% DEF DMG and 140% DEF [Bleed] DMG to a single enemy, with a 60% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Bleed] for 2 turns. Afterward, transfers up to 3 layers of debuffs from self to the target and refreshes the duration.
Psionic LanternActiveExclusive Lv.1
Grants all allies [DEF Up Ⅱ] for 2 turns and [Raven's Gaze] for 1 turn. When any ally with [Raven's Gaze] inflicts [Bleed] successfully, removes [Raven's Gaze] from them and triggers Raven's Blessing: Gains [Bleed Up I] for 1 turn. Narch gains 1 layer of [Raven's Feather] when [Raven's Gaze] is removed because of its effect is triggered and when the duration of [Raven's Gaze] ends.
Psionic Grave Keeper Lv.1Increases the duration of [Raven's Gaze] inflicted by Psionic Lantern to 2 turns. Also, Raven's Blessing will also be triggered and enhanced when any ally with [Raven's Gaze] deals [Bleed] DMG: Cleanses all attribute debuffs and gains [Block Debuff] for 1 turn. Upgrades [Bleed Up I] inflicted to [Bleed Up II].
Raven of DarknessPassiveExclusive Lv.2
While Narch is alive, Narch gains 1 layer of [Raven's Feather] and restores all allies' HP by 3.5% of his Max HP when [Bleed] owned by any enemy is triggered. If an ally doesn't have any [Shield] when receiving restoration, triggers Raven's Protection: Gains a [Shield] equal to 12% of Narch's Max HP for 2 turns. [Raven's Feather]: Each layer increases [Bleed] DMG dealt by 6%, up to 12 layers. Will not be removed at the wave transition. The [Bleed] DMG inflicted by Narch is calculated based on his DEF instead.
Psionic Grave Keeper Lv.2When Raven of Darkness is triggered, Narch additionally gains 1/2/3 layers of [Raven's Feather] if the target has 3/6/10 or more layers of [Bleed]. The requirement to trigger Raven's Protection is changed to: having 2 or fewer layers of Shield when receiving restoration effect. Also, increases the Shield value gained via Raven's Protection to 125% of the original.
Storm of RavensActiveExclusive Lv.3
Deals 4 stages of 100% DEF DMG and 120% DEF [Bleed] DMG each to a single enemy. Each stage has a 50% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Bleed] for 2 turns. If Narch has 8 or more layers of [Raven's Feather] when casting Storm of Ravens, removes 8 layers of [Raven's Feather] and gains enhancement according to the number of enemies after Storm of Ravens is cast: 2 or more enemies: deals DMG to all enemies instead. Only 1 enemy: Increases [Bleed] DMG dealt by each stage to 240% of the original. Also, there is a 50% chance to additionally inflict 1 layer of [Bleed] for 2 turns after each stage inflicts [Bleed] successfully.
Psionic Grave Keeper Lv.3At the beginning of Narch's turns, if layers of [Raven's Feather] owned is less than 8, gains 2 layers of [Raven's Feather]; if not, reduces the CD of Storm of Ravens by 1 turn immediately and gains 1 layer of [Raven Guardian] for 2 turns. Refreshes [Raven Guardian]'s duration when it's gained repeatedly. [Raven Guardian]: Increases Mastery by 25%, up to 7 layers.
